summary: Bloglite is a self-hosted micro-blogging platform designed as an alternative to mainstream social networks like Twitter and Bluesky. It provides built-in syntax highlighting for code snippets and supports mobile publishing for remote updates.
goodFor: It is a suitable option if you want a lightweight, self-contained micro-blogging channel for personal thoughts or technical snippets without relying on commercial platforms.
watchOut: Development activity has slowed down significantly, and the project overlaps heavily with many established micro-blogging and status-update alternatives.
deployNotes: Because it runs via Docker, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for your data and place it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
